Browse the store

Welcome to the HendogSMP store

Everything you buy here helps keep the server running. Keys open the same crates everybody else opens, and you can read every reward and its exact chance before you pay.

Keys are added to your account automatically after payment. You can check them in game with /keys.

Questions? Open a ticket in our Discord.

Crate keys

Pick a pack size. Bigger packs cost less per key. Prices are in US dollars.

Six crates at spawn

Right-click a crate to open it with a key. Left-click one to see everything inside. Every reward is listed with its odds, here and in game.

The PvP zone

Step into the red circle in the plaza. Every 30 seconds it sends you into a free-for-all zone.

Every 30 minutesThe zone is deleted and rebuilt as a fresh 1000 by 1000 map in the next biome.
King of the hillStand alone on the hill for 120 seconds to win $250,000.
Loot chestOne appears 15 minutes in, locked inside obsidian.
You can lose itemsAnything you carry can drop when you die in the zone.

Join us

  1. In Minecraft Java Edition open Multiplayer and choose Add Server.
  2. Paste and join.
  3. Talk to the villagers in the market for the shop, auction house and daily reward.
